question: Who among the following Indian women boxers was elected as the Chairperson and a voting member of the International Boxing Association in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lovlina Borgohain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Lovlina Borgohain is an Indian amateur boxer who won a bronze medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the women's welterweight event.
 
• In December 2022, Lovlina was elected as the Chairperson and a voting member of the International Boxing Association (IBA) Athletes' Committee.
 
• She has also won a bronze medal in the 2018 and 2019 AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships.
 
• Lovlina Borgohain hails from Assam, India, and is known for her significant contributions to Indian boxing on an international platform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Boxing Association (IBA)**

 
 
• The International Boxing Association (IBA), formerly known as AIBA, is a worldwide governing body for the sport of boxing, both amateur and professional.
 
• It was established in 1946 and aims to promote and develop boxing globally while ensuring fair and equal opportunities for all boxers.
 
• The IBA organizes major international boxing events, including the World Boxing Championships and the Women's World Boxing Championships.
 
• It also works to implement rules and regulations for the sport, ensuring the safety and integrity of boxing competitions.
 
 
 
• **AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships**
 
 
• The AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships is an international event organized by the International Boxing Association (IBA) for female boxers.
 
• The competition features multiple weight categories, allowing women boxers from different countries to compete for world titles.
 
• The championship is held biennially and has been instrumental in promoting women's boxing on a global scale.
 
• It provides a platform for female boxers to showcase their skills and gain international recognition.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**
 
 
• The Tokyo 2020 Olympics was an international multi-sport event held in Tokyo, Japan, from July 23 to August 8, 2021, after being postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• It featured competitions in 33 sports and 339 events, with athletes from over 200 countries participating.
 
• The Tokyo 2020 Olympics was notable for its strict COVID-19 protocols and the absence of spectators in most venues.
 
• India achieved its best-ever medal tally at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, winning a total of 7 medals, including 1 gold.
